description.value: This Subway franchise sits on Menzies Street in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, close to the Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park — a convenient refuelling stop on a popular cycling corridor. It offers the full Subway menu of Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads with in-restaurant dining, takeout, curbside pickup, and delivery. Breakfast service is also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, active Subway franchise at 239 Menzies St, Victoria, BC V8V 2G6, matching the OSM phone number (250) 480-7724 exactly. OSM tag 'takeaway: yes' is corroborated by the website's explicit mentions of 'Order Pick Up,' 'curbside pickup,' and delivery options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are left null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (08:00-22:00 flat) does not match the varied daily hours shown on the website; OSM data may be stale.
OSM address fields are empty; full address 239 Menzies St, Victoria, BC V8V 2G6 was sourced from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible fast-food restaurant confirmed by the brand's own location page; useful to touring cyclists for food and takeout.
